units.source_text: 河流上游破旧的空房，成了清爽整洁的艺伎馆。

en.t: The shabby vacant house upstream along the river became a fresh, neat geisha house.

units.source_text: 连她们都感到吃惊的是，阿绢竟迁到那里去了。

en.t: What surprised even them was that Akinu had actually moved there.

units.source_text: 她们也曾被那个貌似赌徒的汉子的甜言蜜语引诱……

en.t: They too had once been tempted by the sweet words of that man who looked like a gambler...

units.source_text: 一回想起那个时候诱人的金额，她们又恶狠狠地咒骂起阿绢来了。

en.t: Whenever they remembered the tempting sum of money from that time, they began cursing Akinu bitterly all over again.
